turn_of_two_cuts: R = -iota C3 : the turn of the two-cut carrier is iota times the third cut
invariants: three: h.h , k.k , h.k   (two cuts had two: m^2 and W)
two_cut_case: W = minus the third component of k : the missed part points along the cut the two-cut frame does not have
phase: a frame change by a phase does nothing ; multiplying the element by Exp(iota chi) turns (h, k) by chi
